style: Wagnerian music drama, late-Romantic German opera. A lone Heldentenor, dark baritonal middle and a ringing, steel-bright top, sings with heroic stamina in long-breathed, declamatory phrases, slow and broad, never hurried. Enormous orchestra: smoky Wagner tubas and low trombones repeat a grinding, ominous printing-press leitmotif. Brooding cellos and basses, tremolo violins, restless chromatic harmony that keeps delaying its resolutions, an endless through-composed flow with no song breaks. Swelling climaxes sink into hushed, shadowy stillness. Deep, warm, covered-pit concert hall acoustic, natural classical recording.
exclude: choir, backing vocals, rap, fast tempo, drum kit, pop production, autotune, screaming
